findings.detail: Explicit dash fair values representing zero were normalized as missing, causing 47 false-null fair_value leaves.

rationale: The filing's Fair Value column explicitly reports a dash (zero) for investment leaves such as table 9 rows 7 and 8, while B01 reports 47 leaves without fair_value and zero residual fair value. The filing total is $877.060 million versus the extracted $877.069 million, confirming that the B01 failure is not a material omitted-value residual; it is an extraction/normalization defect in which explicit source zeros are stored as null.
